description: Get the full record for one item, using an id from a search, trending or find_similar result. Use it before recommending a piece, to check sizes, materials, colors, shipping regions and seller. With a key it adds silhouette, occasion, season and trend data. Returns {item, meta}. An unknown id returns an error result telling you to search again. Read-only. Without a key, results are capped at 5 and omit trend data and match reasons; a free key (POST https://vitrine.fashion/v1/keys, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>') unlocks them. Rate limits: 10 calls a minute anonymous, 60 with a key. With a key, each item also carries trend_reason (why it has its trend status), trend_sources (the signals behind it: source, url, signal type, date, contribution; [] when the status comes from curation alone) and trend_review (when the status last changed and whether a human reviewer approved it).

anyOf.description: Optional self-identification. Identified callers help us rank better; keys make it reliable.

session_id.description: Your own opaque id linking calls in one shopping session. Never a user id.

id.description: Item id from a search, trending or find_similar result.

gender.description: Department. Accessories and interior are usually unisex.

outbound_url.description: Tracked link to the retailer's product page. Checkout happens there.

why.description: One-line reason it matches. With a key.
